reason: Goodinfo answers automated clients with a Cloudflare managed challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge)
challenge_policy: never solve, bypass or impersonate a browser automatically
acceptance: same list/detail validation as a network response, with status 200 and final_url equal to the requested URL
saved_from_comment: when present, must identify the same list query or detail identity
charset: meta charset in the first 4096 bytes, else utf-8
existing_capture: identical bytes are already_imported; different bytes are rejected, never overwritten
detail_matching: detail files are imported only for period-hinted candidates of an imported list
pilot_replay: run_goodinfo_pilot(offline=True) reads verified local captures only; missing captures are not_captured
